text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with 
Fenomeno...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Fenomeno is 
pointing, I spot a crane game filled with 
Umamusume plushies.
choice_data_list:
Phenomeno, so you're interested in Paka 
Puchi?

Phenomeno, are you interested in Paka 
Puchi?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I just remembered seeing some 
children happily holding one earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If I have that, it might make it easier 
for people to feel close to me, or—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That's it! No matter how much I strive to 
be a role model for the children, if 
they're terrified of me and won't even 
look my way, it completely defeats the 
purpose...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"However! If I have that plushie, they're 
sure to look at me with fondness!"
choice_data_list: Then I'll have to work hard and win it!
Then I've got to do my best to get it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sir, yes, sir! Regarding that matter, this 
officer is somewhat unfamiliar with games 
of that nature.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So... Boss, if you wouldn't mind, could 
you please show me how it's done?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
